title: Protoplanetary Disks in the Hostile Environment of Carina
question: Are protoplanetary disks present in Carina's evaporating gas globules and the Tr 14 core, and what do their masses imply for external photo-evaporation?

what.value: Dust mass opacity kappa(1300um)=0.015 cm2/g, 100:1 gas-to-dust

evidence.quote: κ 1300µ _m_ = 0 . 015 cm [2] g [−][1] (Ossenkopf & Henning 1994, assuming a 100:1 gas-to-dust mass ratio)

what.value: Cluster UV luminosity Q_H values for Tr 14 and Tr 16

evidence.quote: The cluster has an UV luminosity ( _Q_ _H_ ) of 2 × 10 [50] photon s [−][1] (SB08)
The EGG mass is estimated as _M_ EGG = 0 . 1–0 . 3 _M_ ⊙ (Sahai et al. 2012)

recipe.method: clean on calibrated visibilities, line-free channels averaged
gaussfit on natural-weighted image in 0.2'' x 0.2'' box
compare flux densities between 220 and 237 GHz spectral windows
optically thin isothermal dust: Mdisk = S D^2 /(B(Tdust) kappa)
assumptions: kappa=0.015 cm2/g, 100:1 gas-to-dust, Tdust=40 K (also 20 K), D~2.3 kpc

recipe.method: analytic EUV/FUV mass-loss estimates scaled with Q_H and distance; compare with Orion proplyds

answer_key.quantity: Mass upper limit for non-detections (4σ, 40 K)

evidence.quote: average de-convolved size of 0 . 05 [′′] × 0 . 03 [′′] ≈ 120 AU × 70 AU

answer_key.quantity: EUV evaporation timescale of disks at Tr 14 core

evidence.quote: short as 10 [5] years for an initial disk mass of 50 _M_ Jup

not_stated_but_needed: Number of clean iterations, threshold, masking and cell/image size
Whether the pipeline or manual calibration scripts were used
Details of the spectral index measurement (per-spw fluxes)
Phase centers of fields beyond Table 1
score_reason: Project code and key imaging settings given, but clean details and calibrator flux are missing; analysis is simple.
rediscovery_reason: Cycle 3 data likely public, short recipe, numeric fluxes and masses.
